title: Optional Mosquitto missing: stop spamming every kbs command
description:
Ryan 2026-09-09 dogfood: when Mosquitto is not installed, kbs prints a warning on every command invocation.

Example seen during dogfood:
Mosquitto not found. Install with: brew install mosquitto (macOS) or apt install mosquitto (Debian/Ubuntu).

## Expected

Mosquitto is optional for console pub/sub. Warn once per session, only when a command actually needs MQTT, or gate behind an explicit diagnostic flag.

## Observed

The install hint repeats on routine commands such as create, show, and list, adding noise to agent transcripts.
